About Anantacast

A dedicated precision manufacturing partner providing integrated casting and machining solutions across diverse global markets. At Anantacast, we believe industrial manufacturing is more than rough melting - it's about skilled metallurgists, repeatable processes, and exceptional precision that keep your mechanical equipment running smoothly. With 150+ trained foundry technicians and a proven track record serving automotive manufacturers, industrial equipment OEMs, and valve producers, we deliver turnkey casting, CNC machining, heat treatment, and metrology services tailored to meet every client's engineering needs.

Our Principles

Our quality-first framework guides everything we manufacture, ensuring exceptional precision and enduring technical partnerships with OEMs.

Metallurgical Precision

Skilled metallurgists, exceptional tolerances

Our 150+ trained foundry technicians undergo rigorous metallurgical certification to deliver consistent, high-quality metal casting products across all production touchpoints.

Dimensional Traceability

Verified metallurgy, honest communication

We believe in transparent reporting and certified metrology, ensuring our OEM sourcing clients always know what to expect from our shipments.

Single-Source Reliability

Empowering industrial manufacturing

We focus on developing long-term relationships with our OEMs, mastering their technical drawings and scaling together through consistent manufacturing excellence.

What We Make

Comprehensive turnkey casting manufacturing services tailored to meet complex procurement needs across diverse industrial sectors.

Patternmaking

Precision patternmaking services for high-tolerance casting production with modern CAD design and trained technicians.

Foundry Casting

High-integrity metal casting solutions using modern, certified techniques to deliver your components with defect-free metallurgy.

CNC Machining

Comprehensive precision milling and turning operations ensuring optimal drawing tolerance and concentricity.

Heat Treatment

Specialized controlled atmosphere thermal conditioning services to ensure clean, correct, uniform mechanical strength.

Finishing

Quality shot blasting for raw castings and machined surfaces with certified operators.

Metrology Inspection

Professional coordinate measuring machine validation services ensuring exact and verifiable tolerances.

Spectrometric Analysis

Certified alloy chemical spectrometry and testing services for production melt heats.

Mechanical Assembly

Comprehensive technical inspection for metallurgical, mechanical, and dimensional properties.

Protective Packaging

Corrosion-resistant custom crating services including export barrier packing and handling.

Our Evolution

From foundry origins to becoming an integrated precision casting partner.

About Our Enterprise

Anantacast Precision Foundry was established with a clear mission: to elevate metal casting across industrial manufacturing sectors by combining skilled metallurgists with modern precision machining.

Starting as a foundry casting provider, we quickly recognized the need for comprehensive turnkey manufacturing solutions that go beyond basic rough cast metal.

Today, we serve over 10 industrial sectors globally, from automotive power systems to heavy machinery, delivering end-to-end precision cast products with certified excellence.

Key Milestones

2016

Inaugurated dedicated foundry manufacturing in Rajkot

2020

Expanded operations to include precision machining and heat treatment

2022

Reached 100+ precision components milestone

2024

Achieved 98% on-time dispatch rating
